doc.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016

title: Maxwell tour, a planned Black Radio gospel album, Bobby Jones show
summary: He toured with Maxwell 2009-2013, plans a gospel album, and once played on Bobby Jones's show as a teenager.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I’ve played with Maxwell for five years, and in 2009 when he came back with “Pretty Wings” and all that stuff, so I did that tour, from ’09 to 2013, and my boy Shedrick Mitchell was on organ on a church gig every Sunday. But he was telling me, that’s why I know a lot of these things because he was like he said, “yeah my pastor — I always sang that stuff — it fascinates people.” But I thought you were going to ask me if I was going to do a Gospel album. Because I am. I’m going to do a Black Radio Gospel album.
Is this the first time you said it anywhere?
No. I’ve been saying it for like two years now.
Bobby Jones’s going to do it first.

Right. The funny thing is, I played on Bobby Jones’ show when I was in eleventh grade. Didn’t Bobby Jones get canceled? I think he’s off the air now. This is the last year. Yeah, I played with a choir on there when I was in high school. I’ll never forget that.
